title: Casarabe culture settlements, Llanos de Mojos
summary: Lidar surveys in the Llanos de Mojos of Bolivia revealed settlements of the Casarabe culture, dated to around 500 to 1400 CE. Two large sites of 147 and 315 hectares anchor a four-tiered system linked by raised causeways, with platforms and conical pyramids up to 22 m tall, canals and reservoirs. The authors call it tropical low-density urbanism.

uncertainty.note: Nature gives "around ad 500 to ad 1400" for the Casarabe culture.

reviewer_note: Pin is the OSM village of Casarabe, Beni, as a rough centre of a culture area of about 4,500 km2; the paper gives no coordinates for Cotoca or Landívar (I did not find them), so uncertainty is set at 60 km. No model: it is a region of sites, not one structure. The paper says one site controls about 500 km2, which does not match the hectare figures, and gives Cotoca's core earth volume inconsistently.
